items.title: Unity CLI 1.0 is here
items.excerpt: Announced at Unite Tokyo: the Unity CLI and Pipeline package are out of beta at 1.0, ready for projects, build machines and AI agents driving Unity from the terminal.
items.rationale: Primary-source GA release: Unity's CLI and Pipeline package leave beta at 1.0, which lets AI coding agents drive Unity projects and builds from the terminal. Teams can act on it right away.

items.title: Video Game Union Manifesto Calls On Consumers To 'Support Games Made Without GenAI'
items.excerpt: The joint collective made up of six European video game unions has urged consumers to 'be vocal about disliking GenAI in games'
items.rationale: New labour-side event: six European game unions publish a joint manifesto asking players to back games made without GenAI. It is a fresh organised move, not more commentary on a story we already ran.

items.title: 指定されたワードを履歴書に盛り込んで書類審査を突破。AI面接官との面接に挑むゲーム「AI面接官を突破せよ」，Steamで配信中
items.excerpt: MeteorWing's 'AI面接官を突破せよ' is out on Steam (280 yen): players write a résumé with assigned keywords, then face an AI interviewer that generates questions on the spot from what they wrote.
items.rationale: New release in which the AI is the game itself: an LLM interviewer writes its questions live from the player's résumé. It is a concrete example of AI-native game design.

items.title: [판례.zip] AI에 게임 도둑맞았는데, 어떻게 대응하죠?
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI의 발전으로 인해 인디게임의 플레이 영상을 무단 분석하여 비슷한 게임을 먼저 출시하는 역설계 문제가 대두되고 있습니다. 대법원 판례에 따르면 단순한 장르적 규칙을 넘어 개별 요소가 선택되고 배열된 창작적 표현의 조합이 유사한지가 핵심 판단 기준이 됩니다. 따라서 개발자...
items.rationale: Practical Korean legal guide for indie developers facing AI-made clones of their games. It uses Korean Supreme Court precedent to explain when a combination of game elements counts as protected expression, which is new and actionable for local studios.
